description: Defines the FrameProcessor class for processing camera frame metadata and managing 3A (auto-exposure, auto-focus, auto-white balance) states in Android's camera2 API implementation.

classes.name: FrameProcessor
classes.description: A thread class for processing output frame metadata, handling face detection, lens state, and 3A state changes in camera frames.

classes.name: AlgState
classes.description: Structure to hold auto-focus, auto-white balance, and auto-exposure states for a frame.

methods.name: FrameProcessor
methods.description: Constructor initializing the frame processor with device and client references.

methods.name: processNewFrames
methods.description: Processes new frames received from the camera client.

methods.name: processSingleFrame
methods.description: Processes a single camera frame, analyzing metadata.

methods.name: processLensState
methods.description: Analyzes lens state from frame metadata.

methods.name: process3aState
methods.description: Updates 3A (auto-exposure, auto-focus, auto-white balance) state based on frame metadata.

methods.name: updatePendingState
methods.description: Helper template to update pending 3A states.

methods.name: callbackFaceDetection
methods.description: Emits face detection events to Java layer if faces change.
